title: miR-603 mediates thyroid cancer progression by inhibiting HACE1-Dependent YAP1 degradation.
authors: Li, Tangya; Chu, Jian; Zhou, Guangjun; Jiang, Guoqin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究miR-603通过靶向HACE1调控YAP1蛋白稳定性促进甲状腺癌进展，属于miRNA-蛋白互作与肿瘤机制研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study delineates the regulatory role of MicroRNA-603 (miR-603) on the molecular dynamics of HACE1 and YAP1 in thyroid cancer (TC). Using a combination of bioinformatics, dual-luciferase reporter assays, and various cellular assays, we identified that miR-603 is significantly overexpressed in TC tissues and cells. Our investigations confirmed that miR-603 targets the 3'UTR of HACE1, suppressing its expression, which in turn affects the ubiquitination and stability of the YAP1 protein. Specifically, HACE1's suppression led to decreased YAP1 degradation, promoting cellular processes associated with tumor progression, such as proliferation, migration, and invasion. These in vitro findings were corroborated by in vivo experiments in a TC xenograft model, demonstrating that miR-603 facilitates tumor growth through stabilization of YAP1 protein by targeting HACE1. These results highlight a novel miRNA-mediated pathway influencing TC pathogenesis and suggest potential targets for therapeutic intervention.
abstract_zh: 本研究阐述了MicroRNA-603（miR-603）在甲状腺癌（TC）中对HACE1和YAP1分子动力学的调控作用。通过结合生物信息学、双荧光素酶报告基因检测及多种细胞实验，我们发现miR-603在TC组织和细胞中显著过表达。我们的研究证实，miR-603靶向HACE1的3'UTR，抑制其表达，进而影响YAP1蛋白的泛素化及稳定性。具体而言，HACE1的抑制导致YAP1降解减少，促进了与肿瘤进展相关的细胞过程，如增殖、迁移和侵袭。这些体外发现通过TC异种移植模型中的体内实验得到验证，表明miR-603通过靶向HACE1稳定YAP1蛋白，从而促进肿瘤生长。这些结果突显了一种新的miRNA介导通路影响TC发病机制，并提示了潜在的治疗干预靶点。
